name: item
title: Item
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova item, fixed: ItemTitle's text, or its ItemLink, is one line ending in an ellipsis (a flex box takes no line clamp: a long title wrapped or ran past its column), as narrow as its column in a grid too (max-w-fit, not w-fit, whose fit-content made Firefox's and WebKit's grid columns as wide as the words); made a button (render={<button />}) it answers hover and a press as a link does, its words start-aligned, disabled faint. The current item (aria-current, e.g. the entry open beside a master–detail list, or a nav row), a selected one (aria-selected) or one marked data-active is on the hover's grey, kept. ItemGroup `columns` (n) lines its items' facts up in columns across them without a table: media where any item has it, content, then n columns (ItemMeta, a fact at an item's end: small, grey, tabular, at its column's end, or start with align="start", gone with hideBelow (md, lg, xl, 2xl, 3xl) where the group is narrower than that, the same in every row, leaving no space; ItemActions, at its column's end), each as wide as its widest, in each item's subgrid; on a phone, a list as without. size="compact": a long list's rows (devices, people, results), 32px as the sidebar's, 8px in, no outline whatever the variant, touching in an ItemGroup. ItemLink: an item's title as its link (or render={<button />}), stretched over the row, its actions above it, the row hovered where it is and its focus ring round the row; an Item render={<a />} is one link, hovered and focused the same. ItemGroupLabel heads a run of its items ("Today"), small and grey where their words start, lighter than a section's title (role="presentation" in a list, or render={<h3 />}). Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md). Its background answers the pointer by the theme's motion-hover. ItemDescription phoneOnly is a line only a phone shows (hidden from sm); the media and a compact row's padding count it only there, so on a desktop the icon stays centred on a one-line title. ItemTitle is no wider than its column (max-w-full), so a part of it cut short (truncate) is cut there, not over the next column. ItemMedia variant="number": a row's number on a 20px round grey mark, its digits of one width, so titles start on one line from 1 to 12.
